overviewHtml:
Teams that share Segments across dashboards need a repeatable way to create and keep them in sync. Doing this manually in the UI makes changes hard to track across environments.

What you get

  • A segment configuration managed with Monaco
  • A dashboard configuration that depends on the segment
  • Automatic inclusion of the segment in the dashboard
  • Manifest and delete files for deploy and cleanup
prereqsHtml:
• Monaco v2.19.0+
  • Dynatrace Platform environment
  • OAuth credentials as described [here][OAuth credentials], including the additional scopes: storage:filter-segments:read, storage:filter-segments:write, storage:filter-segments:delete.
getStartedHtml:
You need Monaco, a Dynatrace Platform environment and an OAuth client with segment scopes.

  1. Point the Monaco manifest at your environment
  2. Deploy the project to create the segment and dashboard
  3. Adapt the segment definition to your needs
